title: Leave and Time Off Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Human Resources
Policy: Leave and Time Off Policy

Employees receive 18 annual leave days, 10 sick leave days and 6 casual leave days per calendar year. Annual leave requests should be submitted at least 3 working days in advance and require manager approval. Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward. Emergency leave must be communicated to the manager as soon as possible.

title: Remote Work Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Human Resources
Policy: Remote Work Policy

Employees become eligible for remote work after completing 3 months of employment. Eligible employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Employees must use company-approved devices and connect through the company VPN. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

title: Business Expense Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Finance
Policy: Business Expense Policy

Business travel requires manager approval before booking. Expense claims must be submitted within 15 calendar days after the trip. Original receipts are required for claims above INR 500. Personal expenses are not reimbursable.

title: IT Security Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Information Technology
Policy: IT Security Policy

Multi-factor authentication is required for company accounts. Passwords must never be shared. Company data must not be stored on personal cloud drives. Remote access to internal systems requires the company VPN. Lost or stolen company devices must be reported to IT immediately.

title: Incident Management Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Operations
Policy: Incident Management Policy

P1 incidents must be acknowledged within 15 minutes and escalated immediately to the on-call lead. P2 incidents must be acknowledged within 1 hour. Incident records must include impact, timeline, owner, mitigation and resolution details.

title: Parental Leave Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Human Resources
Policy: Parental Leave Policy

Eligible employees receive 26 weeks of maternity leave. Eligible fathers receive 15 working days of paternity leave. Employees must notify HR and provide required documentation. Leave scheduling should be coordinated with HR.

title: Access Management Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Information Technology
Policy: Access Management Policy

Access requests must be submitted through the service desk and approved by the employee's manager and system owner. Access is granted using least-privilege principles. Access must be reviewed when an employee changes role or leaves the company.

title: Procurement Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Procurement
Policy: Procurement Policy

Purchase requests require a business justification and budget-owner approval. Purchases above INR 250000 require at least three vendor quotations unless an approved exception is documented. Purchase orders must be issued before goods or services are received.

title: Software Deployment Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Engineering
Policy: Software Deployment Policy

Production deployments require an approved change record, peer review and a rollback plan. High-risk changes must be scheduled during an approved maintenance window. Deployment outcomes must be recorded in the release log.

title: Data Handling Policy
content:
Company: TechNova Solutions
Department: Legal and Compliance
Policy: Data Handling Policy

Confidential company information must only be shared with authorized recipients. Customer personal data must be accessed only for approved business purposes. Suspected data exposure must be reported to the security team immediately.
